annotations.title: StackDetect: Detect a website tech stack

description:
Detects the technologies a website uses (CMS, ecommerce platform, JS framework, web server, CDN/hosting, analytics, ad pixels, chat, payments, consent tools) from one page load. Free preview tier: technology names and categories. The paid x402 endpoint /v1/detect adds versions, confidence and evidence plus email / DNS / hosting providers and verified SaaS from public DNS.

[StackDetect via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as StackDetect's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: detect $0.003 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

tier.description: Paid tier: detect $0.003. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL or a bare domain, e.g. https://laravel.com or shopify.com
